section_summary.extract_value: This procedure section describes a study conducted between September 2014 and October 2015 where female participants fluent in Dutch were recruited from two universities in the Netherlands (Maastricht University and VU University Amsterdam) via campus advertisements and online recruitment systems. Participants completed an online survey, provided electronic informed consent, selected compensation options (research credit or gift certificate entry), and were debriefed, with ethics approval from Maastricht University.
